fullTextZH: 今天我想和你们聊聊我的以前的经理。
fullTextEN: Today I want to talk to you about my former manager.
I didn't have anyone I disliked before.

fullTextZH: 今天我要说说我讨厌他的6个点。
fullTextEN: Today I will talk about the 6 things I dislike about him.
First point, he is very lazy.

fullTextZH: 他每天叫我们帮他擦桌子。
fullTextEN: He asks us to help him wipe the table every day.
We have to get up very early.

fullTextZH: 然后去公司帮他做这些事。
fullTextEN: Then go to the company to help him with these things.
Sometimes he is an hour late.

fullTextZH: 所以我们只能听他骂我们。
fullTextEN: So we can only listen to him scold us.
Then get angry in our hearts.
His salary is higher than ours.
Also, he doesn't buy a car.

fullTextZH: 所以他常常开我们的车。
fullTextEN: So he often drives our car.
He also doesn't say thank you to us.

fullTextZH: 他常常对女生做奇怪的事情。
fullTextEN: He often does strange things to girls.

fullTextZH: 他会突然抓一下我的头发。
fullTextEN: He might suddenly grab my hair.
This makes me feel very uncomfortable.

fullTextZH: 他觉得大家都很喜欢他。
他想要公司里的女生做他的女朋友。
fullTextEN: He wants a girl from the company to be his girlfriend.

fullTextZH: 但是没有一个女生要做他的女朋友。
fullTextEN: But no girl wants to be his girlfriend.
I stood up from the chair.

fullTextZH: 拍着桌子说：“这不是我的错。”
fullTextEN: I slapped the table and said, "This is not my fault."
You only know how to be late every day.
I felt, hmm, very comfortable inside.

fullTextZH: 现在我不用每天看到老张。
fullTextEN: Now I don't have to see Old Zhang every day.

fullTextZH: 朋友们，你们的经理是什么样子的呢？
fullTextEN: Friends, what does your manager look like?

fullTextZH: 你喜欢你的经理还是讨厌你的经理？
fullTextEN: Do you like your manager or hate your manager?
